timed_text.text: Before we go any further — we need a starting point.
Think of this like measuring your vertical before a training block.
One for each pillar — Mindfulness, Acceptance, Commitment.
10 means you've got it locked in.
Read it, sit with it, and be honest.

steps.text: Mindfulness — During competition, how often does your mind drift to outcomes, mistakes, or what people think — instead of staying on the task in front of you? 1 = constantly, 10 = never.
Acceptance — How much do nerves, fear, or self-doubt affect your performance — even when you know physically you're ready? 1 = they control me, 10 = I use them.
Commitment — How consistent are your mental habits right now — visualization, reflection, intentional prep? 1 = nonexistent, 10 = locked in daily.

timed_text.text: Those three numbers are your baseline.
On Day 30, you're going to answer those exact same questions again.
Write your scores down and add one sentence explaining each one.
After you finish — Day 3 is complete.

blocks.prompt: Write your three baseline scores — M, A, C — and one sentence explaining each one.
